_comment: A worked example of the import format, and the thing that keeps the importer honest -- tools/ci.sh generate slices this on every run, so the path a real pack takes is exercised even when no real pack is installed. Copy this directory, drop in the sheet you downloaded, fix the four geometry numbers, delete this one.
name: example-harbour
author: Port Azure
_scale: This example was drawn for the pre-migration 32x16 grid. Rather than redraw it, it is magnified by a whole number on the way in -- which is exactly what a real pack drawn at half this project's scale should do. See assets/packs/README.md.
